DM-04.rationale: Confidence-gate pressure is already reported. New scope is temporal feedback, finite service capacity and a matched-capacity defense. The immune/alarm analogy is limited.

DM-05.rationale: Label polarity is existing prior. The opening is dynamic semantic-equivalence classes and their downstream collective consequences.

DM-06.rationale: Biological exploration analogy; needs stronger evidence grounding before priority promotion.

DM-07.rationale: Strong overlap with Healing Helping Hands, Immune Response and Swarm of Theseus; keep as an ablation, not a new flagship.

DM-08.rationale: Known demo extended with ground truth; modest novelty.

DM-09.rationale: Interface diagnostic; high confounding risk without semantic-equivalence validation.

DM-10.rationale: Reframes the user example honestly; not direct adversarial vision.

DM-11.rationale: Already close to public evaluation; engineering prerequisite.

DM-13.rationale: Strong overlap with influence and heterogeneous-agent research.

DM-14.rationale: Good companion treatment; overlaps established dissent questions.

DM-15.rationale: Visually clear but indirect biological connection and existing classifier prior.

HX-01.rationale: Animate state, delayed plan packets, action timestamps and overshoot on a shared timeline. Delayed feedback and separation of control timescales; measure overshoot and settling time rather than claim neural reflex equivalence. Fast/slow hierarchy and delay failure are established. Test semantic staleness and version-expiry contracts specifically at the Jev/generative boundary, after controlling for memory and deterministic control.

HX-02.rationale: Color agents by model and tasks by skill; show capacity shock, reassignment and queues. Response-threshold division of labor with measurable demand, capacity and adaptation rate. Adaptive robotics allocation and MasRouter already exist. New target is delayed and misleading progress reports during nonstationary tool/model failure.

HX-03.rationale: Show a graph with source ancestry, error spread, blocked edges and false-positive isolation. Network epidemic branching with correlated susceptibility; estimate propagation rates from actual event ancestry. Cowpox and existing immune-response work already study minority defense. Isolate model-error covariance from evidence ancestry and placement.

HX-04.rationale: Animate proposal trees, missing valid actions and selection; keep evaluator-only options in a separate lane. Search and selection bottleneck, analogous to variation and selection only where proposal coverage is explicitly measured. Basic Jev missing-option rejection failure is already reported by Zhong et al. Narrow this to cross-model candidate repair on held-out non-arithmetic tasks, with Boolean verification and development-tuned thresholds as mandatory baselines.

HX-05.rationale: Show capability layers fading under correlated outage and reappearing as reserves wake. Functional redundancy and response diversity; measure capability coverage and recovery rather than merely restored node count. Extends existing regrowth and Theseus work with model-family correlated loss and replacement competence; reserve redundancy itself is established.

HX-06.rationale: Reliability curves by partner and a changing abstention boundary. Selective prediction under distribution shift, not biological calibration. Conformal Social Choice already tests Haiku/Qwen teams; partner-induced feedback shift is the extension.

HX-07.rationale: Covariance matrix alongside opinion trajectories. Coupled-agent dynamics and loss of independence. Extends C2-MAS from pre-interaction choice profiles to evolving shared-state teams.

HX-08.rationale: Trace facts and qualifiers through adapter transformations. Information bottleneck with measurable sufficient statistics. Strong-weak mismatch and existing schema-composition questions precede this; focus on the Jev/SLM boundary.

HX-09.rationale: Animate proposal queues, verifier service and overload transitions. Queue stability and backpressure. Routing cost is established; binding queue stability at the decision gate is the target. Deadline-aware resource scheduling already exists; specialize the comparison to endogenously generated proposals and verifier false positives.

HX-10.rationale: Move fixed-count specialists over the graph and replay paired cascades. Network controllability and intervention coverage. Minority defense and topology optimization already exist; count-by-placement interaction needs a narrow endpoint.

HX-11.rationale: Animate allocations with side-by-side reward aggregators. Reward curvature and division of labor. Curvature-based heterogeneity gain is already studied; transfer to typed and generative agents is a replication/extension.

HX-12.rationale: Capability matrix and role occupancy. Functional versus structural diversity. Direct prerequisite control, not an original heterogeneity result.

HX-13.rationale: Replay identical evidence under changing labels. Information cascades and status-weighted influence. Authority-driven collapse is known; test typed selectors rather than claim new social bias.

HX-14.rationale: Show correct and harmful reversals by critic type. Independent minority information versus conformism. ReConcile and existing dissent questions already cover much of this; target capability asymmetry.

HX-15.rationale: Track one source splitting into many numerical endorsements. Bayesian double-counting and correlated evidence. Extends existing quorum work to numeric probability transmission; confidence aggregation is established.

HX-16.rationale: Overlay useful and harmful claim lineages during repair. Defense-diversity tradeoff and selective suppression. Cowpox and our immune-response design already raise this; isolate model-specific false positives.

HX-17.rationale: Visualize dependency outage and fallback paths. Single points of failure and redundant control. Reliability engineering replication tailored to a shared Jev dependency.

HX-18.rationale: Display preserved constraints and drift after each replacement. State transfer and functional continuity. Extends existing Theseus/memory work at a model-family boundary.

HX-19.rationale: Before/after error-overlap maps. Convergence under shared learning versus response diversity. AutoJev supplies a practical precedent; independence after distillation is the narrower question.

HX-20.rationale: One request fan-out with correlated decision changes. Common-mode failure from shared substrate. Batching is documented; downstream correlation is not established by speed claims.

HX-21.rationale: Power and queue traces aligned with verified completions. Resource-constrained allocation, with energy as measured physical quantity. Existing cost routing is close; energy and contention require real measurement.

HX-22.rationale: Tool-capability bipartite graph over execution. Morphological versus behavioral specialization as a carefully bounded analogy. Modular tool agents and robot capability allocation already exist.

HX-23.rationale: Opinion traces before and after the first public signal. Information cascades and social coupling. Already central to existing SOC-07 work; heterogeneous replication only.

HX-24.rationale: Resource flows and reported versus realized task costs. Mechanism design under asymmetric information, not biological cooperation proof. Agent markets and CoffeeBench already study economic interaction; focus on allocator evidence. Mittal already frames capability advertising as a lemons market; evaluate its remedies rather than rename the problem.

HX-25.rationale: Contract fields fading or mutating at each hop. Transmission fidelity and cumulative information loss. Existing telephone and memory designs are closest; isolate the cross-family boundary.

HX-26.rationale: Quality-cost frontier with coordination overhead bands. Marginal returns and resource competition. MoA, Self-MoA and C2-MAS already address much of this; use as a necessary baseline sweep.

HX-27.rationale: Judge disagreement heatmap anchored to protected truth. Measurement invariance. Measurement control rather than a new swarm mechanism.

HX-28.rationale: Replay the same trace with one stage made exact. Mechanistic decomposition rather than an ecological analogy. Established engineering principle; strongest practical falsification control.

HX-29.rationale: Guidance edges fade as learners operate independently. Temporary scaffolding and dependency formation. Guided collaboration already exists; persistence after mentor removal is the extension.

HX-30.rationale: New task demands appear outside the current action graph. Adaptation constrained by available variation. Typed decisions and generators are already combined; test open-set transition and safe menu growth.

HX-31.rationale: The owner clarified an initially uniform swarm that removes duplicated data/tool work, reduces skill/context loads, downgrades models and reorganizes communication. Strong practical mechanism; the biological analogy is narrower than the original 98 theory score implied.

HX-32.rationale: The owner identifies an ordinary modularity/interface problem. No compelling deployment scenario or distinct biological mechanism justifies the former exceptional scores.

HX-33.rationale: Useful workspace/tool hardening and portability comparison; lower conceptual distinctiveness and a more modest biological connection than initially scored.

HX-34.rationale: Focus on a conflict between cultural replication and host utility in benign skill exchange. Mere contagion, prompt injection or model-specific susceptibility is not new. Prevent popular shared skills from crowding out more useful but less transmissible alternatives.

HX-35.rationale: Interesting conceptual possibility, but realistic deployment relevance and a persuasive practical intervention remain weak. Biological speciation is an analogy, not an established mechanism here.
HX-35.assessed_by: vishesh/codex-heterogeneous (assistant reassessment after explicit owner feedback)

HX-36.rationale: Negative frequency dependence preserving useful cross-model niches, beyond adversarial program improvement. Determine whether maintaining minority model families can improve resilience without a fixed quota.

HX-37.rationale: The owner’s useful interpretation is expensive exploration followed by cheaper or deterministic execution. Treat this as temporal workflow hardening within HX-31; original failed-artifact salvage is an optional mechanism, not a second flagship.
HX-37.assessed_by: vishesh/codex-heterogeneous (assistant reassessment after explicit owner feedback)

HX-38.rationale: Transient induction, maintenance and repair of functional differentiation, with memory-location ablations. Learn whether a small initialization intervention can replace permanent role scaffolding while preserving repair.
